Birthday. Blessed. Bright!
As I write this, I’m reflecting on the incredible transformation I’ve undergone—mentally, emotionally, and physically—over the years. One thing that’s been constant in me, from childhood to now, is my hyper energy, boundless curiosity, and the audacity to dream big! 

But as I grow older and face life’s challenges, I sometimes feel like the kid in me is fading. Life out there can be tough, yet here I stand—grateful for today. This gratitude wouldn’t be possible without my amazing family and closest friends, who stood by me no matter what. They helped me through my darkest days, from moments of not wanting to live anymore to now embracing life with all its fullness.

Here’s to this one precious life—grateful, hopeful, and always dreaming! :)
